name: Vulcanized Enforcer Brigandine
power: Deflects close-range pistol rounds and blunts severe crushing impacts to the chest.
worth: Salvaged from an elite sector sergeant, it turns aside the standard shotgun pellets common in tunnel ambushes.
use: Strap the thick rubber-and-steel chassis across your torso over your undershirt.
look: A sleeveless waist-length vest of overlapping blackened steel plates sandwiched inside thick industrial conveyor belting, fastened by three rusted brass trunk latches.

name: Lead-Lined Patrol Gorget
power: Protects the throat and jugular from direct bladed slashes.
worth: Scavengers routinely target the exposed throats of officers, making neck protection priceless in tunnel scraps.
use: Buckle the crescent plate firmly under the chin resting on the collarbone.
look: A curved crescent collar of beat-hammered iron lined with flexible sheet lead, fitted with an oxidized leather neck strap and rusted roller buckle.

name: Riot Helmet
look: a black police riot helmet with a clear perspex visor raised, the visor cracked

name: Slag Trench Cleaver
power: Shears through heavy padlocks and calcified biome tissue in one stroke
worth: Forged by desperate miners when standard pickaxes shattered against biome bone.
use: Swung two-handed to cleave barricades or sever mutating organic limbs.
look: A thirty-inch slab of industrial high-carbon extraction saw steel ground into an oversized falchion, bolted to a leather-wrapped iron pipe grip with heat scorch marks along the spine.
